selection_rationale: Developer explicitly identifies this as finished concept art of the base game amusement park. Distinctive setting, balanced architecture and eerie lighting establish identity without gameplay screenshot uncertainty. A centered 16:9 frame trims about 5.3% from each horizontal edge, retaining the castle and entrance. No main character portrait; some edge trees are lost. Prior desert-city image is officially published but its artwork-versus-gameplay classification is not established by the checked source, so it is not approved under the stricter rule. The other finished-art candidate is nearly identical and does not improve crop fit.
usage_notes: Personal informational viewing/download reviewed; PlatinumGames terms restrict derivative uses. No permission to publish or export a cropped infographic is established by this asset-only test.
